name: Islimi
desc: Islamic biomorphic arabesque scrollwork -- split-leaf rumi vines spiral out of a central rosette in N-fold symmetry, forever unfurling, while a band of gilding shimmer travels around and through the medallion so the symmetry never freezes and the leaf tips breathe as if still growing; rendered as gold leaf on a tinted ground, cloisonne enamel in jewel tones, copperplate engraving, or a cyan schematic tracing.

energy.doc: gilding glow, shimmer amplitude and vine highlight contrast

scale.doc: medallion radius -- vines grow larger and spill past the frame

speed.doc: rate of rotation, shimmer sweep and leaf-tip unfurl

fold.doc: N-fold arm count of the arabesque, 5 to 14 arms

style.doc: aesthetic: gold leaf on tinted ground / cloisonne enamel jewel tones / copperplate engraving line / cyan schematic tracing

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws strand spirals, leaf placement and split pattern
